text:
alex_k: Quick async standup for SDKs / quickstarts / sampleapp

What I did: bumped quickstart template to v0.9.2, fixed broken README links, added a small note about Node ESM loader in the JS SDK docs. Pushed sampleapp packaging changes to a branch and opened a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/482

Blocker: sampleapp macOS (Apple Silicon) packaging fails in CI on the native sqlite3 binding. Local repro on my M1: see error below.

maria_devex: can you paste the CI error here? I glanced at the logs but couldn't find the exact stack

alex_k: ```
Error: dlopen(./build/Release/node_sqlite3.node, 1): no suitable image found.
  Referenced from: /workspace/sampleapp/node_modules/sqlite3/lib/sqlite3-binding.node
  Reason: no matching architecture in universal wrapper
```

sam_engineer: probably prebuilds missing for arm64. Try `npm rebuild sqlite3 --build-from-source --verbose` or use `npm install --platform=darwin --arch=arm64` on CI. Worked for me last week.

alex_k: good call, i'll try the rebuild on CI. also thinking to add a tiny CI matrix job for darwin-arm64 so we catch this earlier. @maria_devex — can you review the quickstart wording? i added a note recommending the prebuild step for Apple Silicon users.

jordan_pepper: I can take a look in ~30m and give wording nits.

devex-bot: CI rerun scheduled for branch `alex/sampleapp-m1-fix` (build #2173).

maria_devex: thanks — i'll review the docs change and the sampleapp PR after standup. agree with a CI matrix for darwin-arm64; we should gate it behind an opt-in env var initially to avoid blowing up CI minutes.

sam_engineer: if you need a quick workaround in the sampleapp Dockerfile, add: `RUN npm rebuild sqlite3 --build-from-source --arch=arm64` before the build step. Not ideal but unblocks packaging.

alex_k: will add rebuild to CI temporarily and open a follow-up issue to track proper prebuilds. linking PR again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/482 — if someone can +1 that would be awesome.

maria_devex: i'll open a tiny docs PR for the Apple Silicon callout and link it to your sampleapp PR.

alex_k: thanks all — trying the CI rebuild now. will post results here. :coffee:
